_provenance.methodology: v4.11 ΔT — Standard 1 passes (75 ≥ 15). Standard 3 zone=non_fhsz. Standard 4: project_vehicles = 75 × 1.9 × 0.90 = 128.25 (rounded 128); bottleneck eff_cap = 1125 vph (HCM two-lane @25mph) × 1.00 non-FHSZ degradation; raw ΔT = (128 / 1125) × 60 = 6.83 min. NFPA 101 egress penalty: stories=6 ≥ 4 threshold → 6 × 1.5 = 9.0 min capped at max_minutes=12.0 → penalty = 9.0 min. Total ΔT = 6.83 + 9.0 = 15.83 (rounded 15.84). Threshold = 6.00 min. ΔT > threshold → DISCRETIONARY.
_provenance.source_test_vector: output/berkeley/test_vectors.json (name='Cedar Street Infill'); rolled-up shape from static/multihazard_fixtures.js[cedar_street_infill]
_provenance.notes: Canonical egress-penalty golden — a 6-story project that would pass Standard 4 on raw road capacity alone (6.83 min raw ΔT just over the 6.00 threshold) but gets pushed firmly DISCRETIONARY by the NFPA 101 / IBC building-egress penalty. Validates that the engine correctly applies the stories≥4 penalty and matches it to the right tier.
